name: AI Translate
overview: AI subtitles and voice-over: translate a subtitle or recognise the audio, priced before you choose
description: Adds an AI subtitle provider to Jellyfin's subtitle search: translates an existing subtitle (embedded, external or from another provider) or recognises the speech in the audio track (OpenAI, Google Gemini) and translates it with an LLM. Shows the estimated price before you choose; monthly budget, cost log, stop button and disk clean-up. Also makes a TV-style AI voice-over audio track from subtitles in your language.
